title: Topic 4
japanese_text:
Ａ：初対面の人に<u>好ましい</u>印象を与える服装ってどんな服だと思う？
Ｂ：うーん、年齢<u>相応</u>の服装？
Ａ：確かに、<u>脚</u>を出すような服とか、若い頃の服を着ると余計に<u>老けて</u>見えることあるよね。
english_translation:
A: What kind of clothes do you think make a favorable impression when meeting someone for the first time?
B: Hmmm, age-appropriate clothes?
A: It's true. Wearing clothes from your younger days or clothes that show off too much leg can make you look even older.
